name: Meeting task copy
pitch: Finds meeting notes email and adds its action items to your task list.
instructions: Start by listing your recent mail. When the list appears, search for a message with subject or body containing "meeting notes" or "meeting summary". If nothing is found, say so and stop. When you find the email, read its full body. Look for a list of action items, tasks or next steps. Copy each item into a separate task using the task_create tool. After each task is created, confirm to the person what was added. If the email has no clear action items, say so and stop. Never invent task descriptions; use only what is written in the email.

examples.does: lists recent mail and opens the most recent message with "meeting" in the subject
reads the email body, extracts each task and creates a task for it, then confirms what was added

readme: Meeting notes → task list: finds the email with meeting notes and copies the action items into your task list. Needs access to your mail. Will not send mail, delete messages, or create tasks not found in the email.
